title: Fix Wires Vfs Selection Highlight
description: Sketchpad wires group selection synchronizes VFS row selection but highlighted rows are not shown; nodes and rows are one to one.
summary: Fixed callback tree panel caching so VFS/document row selection refreshes when selectedIds change without row structure changes. Added a regression test and verified renderer tests, WIRES play tests, WIRES Nx build, and a browser smoke on localhost:6015.
